parameters.query:
with
user_ctx as (
    select u.id as user_id, coalesce(s.base_currency, u.default_currency, 'EUR') as base_currency
    from moneytrack.app_users u
    left join moneytrack.user_settings s on s.user_id = u.id
    where u.telegram_user_id = {{ $json.telegram_user_id }}::bigint
    limit 1
),
excluded as (
    select unnest(ARRAY[{{ $json.excluded_sql }}]::bigint[]) as id
),
account_scope as (
    select
        a.id,
        a.parent_id,
        a.currency_code,
        not exists (
            select 1 from moneytrack.accounts c
            where c.user_id = a.user_id and c.parent_id = a.id and c.is_active = true
        ) as is_leaf
    from moneytrack.accounts a
    join user_ctx uc on uc.user_id = a.user_id
    where a.is_active = true
),
selected_leaf_accounts as (
    select a.id
    from account_scope a
    where a.is_leaf = true
      and not exists (select 1 from excluded e where e.id = a.id)
),
transaction_movements as (
    select
        t.account_id,
        case
            when t.transaction_type in ('openingbalance', 'income') then t.amount_original
            when t.transaction_type = 'expense' then -t.amount_original
            when t.transaction_type = 'adjustment' then t.amount_original
            else 0
        end as amount
    from moneytrack.transactions t
    join user_ctx uc on uc.user_id = t.user_id
    where t.transaction_date < ('{{ $json.date_to }}'::date + interval '1 day')
),
transfer_rows as (
    select
        tr.*,
        coalesce(
            nullif(to_jsonb(tr)->>'transfer_date', '')::timestamptz,
            nullif(to_jsonb(tr)->>'transaction_date', '')::timestamptz,
            nullif(to_jsonb(tr)->>'created_at', '')::timestamptz
        ) as movement_ts
    from moneytrack.transfers tr
    join user_ctx uc on uc.user_id = tr.user_id
),
transfer_movements as (
    select tr.from_account_id as account_id, -tr.from_amount as amount
    from transfer_rows tr
    where tr.movement_ts < ('{{ $json.date_to }}'::date + interval '1 day')
    union all
    select tr.to_account_id as account_id, tr.to_amount as amount
    from transfer_rows tr
    where tr.movement_ts < ('{{ $json.date_to }}'::date + interval '1 day')
),
movements as (
    select * from transaction_movements
    union all
    select * from transfer_movements
),
raw_balances as (
    select
        a.id,
        a.parent_id,
        a.currency_code,
        a.is_leaf,
        coalesce(sum(m.amount), 0) as balance_original
    from account_scope a
    left join movements m on m.account_id = a.id
    group by a.id, a.parent_id, a.currency_code, a.is_leaf
),
converted_balances as (
    select
        rb.id,
        rb.parent_id,
        rb.currency_code,
        rb.is_leaf,
        rb.balance_original,
        case
            when rb.currency_code = uc.base_currency then rb.balance_original
            when source_rate.usd_rate is not null and base_rate.usd_rate is not null and source_rate.usd_rate <> 0
                then rb.balance_original * base_rate.usd_rate / source_rate.usd_rate
            else null
        end as balance_base
    from raw_balances rb
    cross join user_ctx uc
    left join lateral (
        select r.usd_rate from moneytrack.exchange_rates_usd r
        where r.currency_code = rb.currency_code and r.rate_date <= '{{ $json.date_to }}'::date
        order by r.rate_date desc limit 1
    ) source_rate on true
    left join lateral (
        select r.usd_rate from moneytrack.exchange_rates_usd r
        where r.currency_code = uc.base_currency and r.rate_date <= '{{ $json.date_to }}'::date
        order by r.rate_date desc limit 1
    ) base_rate on true
),
snapshot_summary as (
    select
        coalesce(sum(cb.balance_base) filter (where cb.id in (select id from selected_leaf_accounts)), 0) as total_base,
        count(*) filter (
            where cb.id in (select id from selected_leaf_accounts) and cb.balance_base is null
        )::bigint as missing_rate_count
    from converted_balances cb
),
snapshot_items as (
    select coalesce(
        jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'account_id', cb.id,
                'parent_id', cb.parent_id,
                'currency_code', cb.currency_code,
                'is_leaf', cb.is_leaf,
                'balance_original', cb.balance_original,
                'balance_base', cb.balance_base
            ) order by cb.id
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
    ) as account_balances
    from converted_balances cb
),
period_transactions as (
    select
        t.transaction_type,
        abs(coalesce(t.amount_original, 0)) as amount_original,
        coalesce(nullif(t.currency_original, ''), a.currency_code, uc.base_currency) as source_currency,
        uc.base_currency,
        t.transaction_date
    from moneytrack.transactions t
    join user_ctx uc on uc.user_id = t.user_id
    join selected_leaf_accounts sla on sla.id = t.account_id
    left join moneytrack.accounts a on a.id = t.account_id and a.user_id = t.user_id
    where t.transaction_date >= '{{ $json.date_from }}'::date
      and t.transaction_date < ('{{ $json.date_to }}'::date + interval '1 day')
),
converted_period_transactions as (
    select
        pt.transaction_type,
        case
            when pt.source_currency = pt.base_currency then pt.amount_original
            when source_rate.usd_rate is not null and base_rate.usd_rate is not null and source_rate.usd_rate <> 0
                then pt.amount_original * base_rate.usd_rate / source_rate.usd_rate
            else null
        end as amount_base_effective
    from period_transactions pt
    left join lateral (
        select r.usd_rate from moneytrack.exchange_rates_usd r
        where r.currency_code = pt.source_currency and r.rate_date <= pt.transaction_date::date
        order by r.rate_date desc limit 1
    ) source_rate on true
    left join lateral (
        select r.usd_rate from moneytrack.exchange_rates_usd r
        where r.currency_code = pt.base_currency and r.rate_date <= pt.transaction_date::date
        order by r.rate_date desc limit 1
    ) base_rate on true
),
period_summary as (
    select
        coalesce(sum(case when transaction_type = 'income' then amount_base_effective else 0 end), 0) as income,
        coalesce(sum(case when transaction_type = 'expense' then amount_base_effective else 0 end), 0) as expense,
        count(*) filter (where amount_base_effective is null)::bigint as missing_rate_count
    from converted_period_transactions
)
select
    uc.user_id,
    uc.base_currency,
    ss.total_base,
    (select count(*) from selected_leaf_accounts)::bigint as included_account_count,
    ss.missing_rate_count as snapshot_missing_rate_count,
    si.account_balances,
    ps.income as period_income,
    ps.expense as period_expense,
    (ps.income - ps.expense) as period_result,
    ps.missing_rate_count as period_missing_rate_count,
    '{{ $json.date_from }}'::date as date_from,
    '{{ $json.date_to }}'::date as date_to
from user_ctx uc
cross join snapshot_summary ss
cross join snapshot_items si
cross join period_summary ps;
